title: The look controls come back above the fold
goal: Now that the section named after what you picked sits at the top of the properties panel, the Corner Radius and Fade sliders have moved down far enough that a piece of text, an arrow or a measurement needs one scroll to reach them. Make room in the panel so the everyday look controls are visible again without giving up the picked-thing-first order.
notes: Measured 2026-09-06 after the picked-first reorder landed. Clean document, text picked: Layers 6-177, Text 177-353, Position & Size 353-488, Appearance 488-623, Effects 623-781, viewport 688 - the Effects header is on screen but Corner Radius sits about 120pt into it, so around 743. Before the reorder Effects sat 417-575 and Corner Radius was reachable. The user weighed this exact tradeoff on 2026-09-06 in the decision "The properties panel holds more than fits on a laptop" and chose picked-first anyway, so this task must NOT undo that order. The unchosen option c is the lead: the layers and measurements lists opening about a third shorter, and Shadow starting closed, gave back roughly 150pt. Harness: Scripts/playtest/dock-picked-first-walk.json, plus the sectionInView waitFor condition added the same day.
acceptance: Picking a piece of text in a 1200 by 720 window shows both its Text section and the Corner Radius slider without scrolling
The same holds for an arrow and for a zoom callout
The section named after what you picked stays at the top of the panel
A playtest walk reads the dock offsets back and proves it
